box_addressed: P2 — Pin the exact Round-5 CORD-19 document revision.
what_this_is: The exact identity of the TREC-COVID Round 5 evaluation set, pinned by retrieved bytes rather than by citation. Every digest below was computed from the file as served by NIST, not copied from a paper.

document_collection.why_this_pin_matters: CORD-19 was re-released continuously and documents changed in place: titles were edited, abstracts and PDFs were added, and cord_uids were reassigned. A Round-5 result is only reproducible against this release, and 'CORD-19' without a date does not identify a document set.

pinned_files.role: the set of document identifiers valid in Round 5
the Round 5 test set of topics
Round 5 chronological qrels; NIST states this one file also serves as the cumulative qrels for Round 5 and as the qrels for TREC-COVID Complete
the record of documents re-judged after a significant change

integrity_checks_that_passed_at_pin_time: all 191175 identifiers in docids-rnd5.txt are unique
the topics file carries exactly 50 topics, numbered 1 through 50
the qrels carry judgments for all 50 topics
all 37924 distinct judged docids are members of the 191175 valid Round-5 identifiers, with zero orphans

anomaly_recorded_not_repaired.observation: 2 of 69318 qrels rows carry judgment -1, outside the documented {0,1,2} scale.
anomaly_recorded_not_repaired.disposition: Recorded, not repaired and not dropped. A consumer must decide explicitly how to treat them; silently coercing or discarding them would change the denominator without saying so.

not_pinned_here.cord19_document_bodies: The CORD-19 full text and metadata are NOT redistributed or hashed here. Only NIST-served identifiers, topics and judgments are pinned. Redistribution of upstream full text is governed by per-article licenses; this artifact pins identity, not content.
not_pinned_here.consequence: Anyone reproducing must obtain the 2020-07-16 CORD-19 release themselves and verify their document set against docids-rnd5.txt.

box_verdict.box: Pin the exact Round-5 CORD-19 document revision.
box_verdict.how: The release is named (2020-07-16), the valid identifier set is pinned by sha256 with its cardinality measured, and the topics, qrels and rejudgment records that define the Round-5 evaluation are pinned the same way. Four integrity checks over the retrieved bytes passed at pin time.
box_verdict.not_claimed: That any retrieval run has been executed against this collection. This artifact creates no result.
